recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-12705 unless a future work group decision changes the Vital Signs Body Weight profile code.
issue_request: FHIR-12705 was a Published/Persuasive Orders and Observations change request for DSTU2. It reported that FHIR-10420 had changed the Body Weight profile code from 59574-4 to 29463-7, but the human-readable text summary on bodyweight.html still showed 59574-4, and it requested fixing the summary code.
initial_application: Git commit 20e489d0d4577bb13967a5310d208b1857c98687, tagged "preapply [#12705],[#12670]", changed summary-BodyWeight in the old observation-vitalsigns-profile-spreadsheet.xml from 59574-4 to 29463-7.
additional_context: FHIR-10420 established that Body Weight should use LOINC 29463-7 instead of 59574-4. In the current source, Observation is active in fhir.ini, the Vital Signs ImplementationGuide includes StructureDefinition/bodyweight, and the Body Weight StructureDefinition and Vital Signs introduction both show 29463-7. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current authoritative source already contains the requested corrected code in the profile summary and constraint.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-10420 supplied the underlying decision to use LOINC 29463-7 for Body Weight instead of 59574-4.
